prompt:
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Meitnerium (마이트너륨) itself — the sovereign of the Meitnerium Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.

1. STYLE
A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance.
Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described below.

2. CHARACTER
Age: early thirties — a poised, graceful face with soft contours; at most faint lines, no deep folds or under-eye bags.
Face — her own: an elegant, refined presence; fair skin; softly tapered face narrowing to a small, soft chin; medium-sized eyes — hooded eyes, outer eye corners drooping downward; thin straight brows; aquiline nose; thin lips with a defined cupid's bow; luminous Cherenkov-blue eyes; smoky dark eye makeup.
Body and hair: lean and long-legged, with a natural neck length build; two hair loops pinned high on the crown with short baby bangs; snow-silver hair divided by one clean parting of soft blue-violet light, each half curling away from the other at the ends.
Expression: a faint wistful smile, soft eyes.
Her element, carried in her design: meitnerium: a heavy synthetic metal below iridium, first made in 1982 in a research city as a single atom, and the only element named for one real woman alone: an exiled physicist who, on a snowy winter walk in a forest, sat on a fallen tree trunk and worked out on scraps of paper that a heavy nucleus can stretch like a trembling drop of liquid and split cleanly in two, releasing great energy; the prize for that discovery went to her colleague alone, and she refused all work on the weapon it made possible.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — MECHA
Costume: she is a female mecha personification — plates, joints, binders and glow lines carry the traits above; the plates must read as solid armor with visible joints, not as cloth or a gown; a back unit may carry the motif. Snow-white and iron-grey armor with a slender torso and oversized mechanical forearms and lower legs, each huge gauntlet and boot cleanly split down its length into two halves with blue-violet light shining from the seam between them, ember-red trim at the break lines, a small core at the chest shaped like a drop pinching in two; the plates must read as solid armor, not a gown.
Silhouette: a slender torso with oversized mechanical forearms and lower legs — huge gauntlets and boots — the contrast is the main shape. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the element's materials and palette.
Colours: winter snow white, iron grey, blue-violet split-light, ember red at the break.
Exposure (bold): her mecha frame is cut open by design in only these places — bare shoulders and upper arms between pauldron and gauntlet, and a deep open chest window with natural cleavage framed by the chest plates; everywhere else she stays fully plated. The plates stay on, fitted and symmetrical, with skin clearly showing in each opening. Nothing slipped off. Intimate areas covered; keep the plate material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: year 2200, a city on a split moon: a vast bridge-city slung between the two cleanly cloven halves of a small moon, blue-violet energy pouring from the cut faces, and white motes of light drifting like snow.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: the scene's own light, rendered the way this style renders light and skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Mt) and atomic number (109) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face, plastic 3D-render finish.
